note: MACD-KR-V1 baseline (STEP 2). MACD(12,26,9) crossover, Long only. Exit = bearish crossover at next open (NOT the static stop/target/time executor contract). Because the crossover exit is not expressible in engine/execution/executor.py's fixed 3-type (STOP/TARGET/TIME_EXIT) contract, this strategy is driven by a dedicated research driver (run_macd_kr_v1_smoke.py) that reuses the engine DATA layer (A2aProvider/UniverseProvider/calendar/_drop_suspension_rows), the engine PORTFOLIO accounting contract (engine.portfolio.Portfolio), CostModel, and engine.metrics - it does NOT reuse engine.executor.simulate_trade (see engine limitations, STEP-1 report §2.8).

signal.entry: MACD Line crosses ABOVE Signal Line (hist: - -> +)
signal.exit: MACD Line crosses BELOW Signal Line (hist: + -> -)

exit.note: Bearish-cross exit is a dynamic (state-machine) exit, NOT a static stop/target/time. Implemented in the research driver, not engine.executor.

pit.rule: no signal on/before ticker's A1a listedAt. Gateway applied at the signal date t: t < listedAt -> signal discarded. Entry is at next_session(t) so it is necessarily after listedAt.

period.note: EMA warm-up uses pre-2016 bars; only trades with signal_date >= performanceStart are generated/measured.
